title: Lesson 2: Requirement Capture as an As-Built Discipline
description: Moving from a problem statement you agree on to a requirement set that survives handover: capturing the enacted process, not the stated one, and writing requirements the next team can run and change without you.

questions.question: Which statement best reflects the lesson’s guidance?
options: The gap between Level 1 and here is the gap between agreeing on a problem and pinning it down so precisely that the build and the handover both survive contact with the client's real world.
